'''Sascha Winter Hidden Base with the help of Anakin''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Sascha Winter]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-19595">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19595 Hidden Base with the help of Anakin], DeckTech (Sascha "Warmaster" Winter, 4 November 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19595/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19595/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016235832/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19595/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Sascha Winter]]
* '''Published:''' 4 November 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Hidden Base with the help of Anakin''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Podrace Prep|Tat-L-podraceprep.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 HB Winter LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck use podrace to retrive some force and the power of the mains for killing the opponent. The Rest is standardHidden Base.

== Original post ==

'''Hidden Base with the help of Anakin'''
* '''Author:''' Sascha "Warmaster" Winter
* '''Published:''' November 4, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This deck use podrace to retrive some force and the power of the mains for killing the opponent. The Rest is standardHidden Base.

=== Strategy ===

Tactic

I use the Podrace to retrive some Force and to play 'I did it

Then I play normal Hidden Base. I use the Mains like Luke, Leia,

Chwei and Obi to battle with the battle destiny adder Rug hug,...

This works very good. And I think that Hidden Base is one of the

best Decks in Star Wars.

That's all thanks for rating me
